rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In production, the 3 static referentiel collections (opc_metiers/opc_filieres/rome_metiers) were empty or under-populated, and GET /api/referentiel/search had no fallback path. When the user searched 'chef cuisinier', the terrain fiches lookup (fiches_metier_opc, separate collection) still worked and displayed the top table, but the merged 'RE’ACTIF PRO + ROME' search returned 0 and rendered the '0 résultat(s)' counter below.
fix_verified: Backend fallback: /api/referentiel/search now, if no metier found in opc_metiers, does a word-AND search across referentiel_opc AND fiches_metier_opc (mapping the fiche terrain's compétences → savoir-être / capacités techniques). Verified via test_fallback_when_collections_empty (wipe 3 collections → still get total=3, 'Remplacement Chef cuisinier' in metiers).
Startup re-seed: on_startup re-seeds opc_metiers if <10, opc_filieres if <5, rome_metiers if <100. Verified: after restart with 3 collections wiped, counts restored to 69/20/1911.
Frontend UX: '0 résultat(s)' no longer appears for 'chef cuisinier' — replaced by '3 résultat(s)' with proper sections.
reproduction_steps_before_fix: 1. On production reactif.pro, log in and navigate to /opc
4. Observe: terrain table shows the fiche BUT below it '0 résultat(s)' for the merged referentiel search
mitigation_steps: Deploy the current /app/backend/server.py (contains the fallback in /referentiel/search) + /app/backend/migrations.py (re-seed thresholds) to production.
After deploy, restart the backend once to trigger the on_startup re-seed of the 3 collections.
